bands.rule: accept |output - expected| <= 0.5 * 10^-decimals(expected), scaled by the expected value's unit (crore/lakh/million literal in the expected text; otherwise absolute). Unit conversion is an exact power of ten. The tolerance never widens with poor extraction.
bands.notes: Replaces the fixed per-share/ratio bands (EPS 0.30 vs 0.80 fails, 19.51 vs 19.5 passes, ratio 0.002 vs 0.05 fails). Percent kept in percentage points.
